authority: SymC General Operations Manual v0.8.6 joint chi/Chi meaning requirement
purpose: qualify what the already-admitted model-specific chi_bio and Chi_bio mean together, and determine whether their relationship is sufficient to explain local and realized NF-kB behavior without collapsing them into one scalar

questions.J1_scalar_sufficiency_for_local_system: Does the chi_bio complex pair identify the spectral-abscissa-setting mode and therefore the slowest/local-dominant linear behavior?
questions.J2_modal_sufficiency_for_local_nonlinear: Does the complete local Chi_bio representation reproduce native nonlinear behavior in the local perturbation limit?
questions.J3_local_vs_finite_window_realized_behav: Does local modal stability sign alone determine the frozen finite-window observed oscillation-amplitude behavior?
questions.J4_information_gain: What scientifically relevant information is gained moving from chi_bio to Chi_bio and from local Chi_bio to realized nonlinear behavior?

predeclared_classifications.SCALAR_SUFFICIENT_LOCAL: the chi_bio pair sets the spectral abscissa and no slower local mode exists
predeclared_classifications.SCALAR_INCOMPLETE_LOCAL: a separate mode sets the spectral abscissa or materially changes local interpretation
predeclared_classifications.MODAL_LOCAL_ROUNDTRIP_SUPPORTED: complete frozen local modal representation passes nonlinear local round-trip
predeclared_classifications.LOCAL_REALIZED_DIRECTION_CONCORDANT: local modal stability sign and finite-window amplitude trend have the same directional interpretation under the frozen behavior rule
predeclared_classifications.LOCAL_REALIZED_DIRECTION_DIVERGENT: local modal stability sign and finite-window amplitude trend differ; preserve as scale/state/attractor information rather than forcing reconciliation

next_if_system_layer_required: adjudicate whether the model-specific scalar/modal/realized-behavior relationship satisfies the project Class-C Bio Chi conglomerate gates at P0-Q; if broad admission remains blocked, preserve the model-specific relationship and proceed to independent B3 ERK transport
